goal: Decide whether Holo Search opens the app an address names, so nothing runs unless its bytes match the address, its model checks and its examples replay.

app.name: holo-open
limits: It does not fetch or hash the bytes; the page does, and passes the results.
app.title: Open policy
app.purpose: Decide, as an XACML policy decision, whether a fetched app may open, from how the address resolved, whether the bytes hash to it, whether the model checks and how many acceptance vectors failed.

fields.name: resolution
fields.means: how the address or name resolved in the registry

fields.name: digest
fields.means: whether the bytes hash to the address

fields.name: check
fields.means: whether LexLean checks the compiled model

fields.name: failed
fields.means: acceptance vectors that did not replay

meanings.permit: the gate is Ready: the app opens
meanings.deny: the gate refuses with its reason: hash mismatch, check failed or vectors failed
meanings.not-applicable: no app the address names was found, so the open policy does not apply
meanings.indeterminate: the address names more than one app, so the policy cannot be evaluated until it is longer

rules.why: src/HoloSearch.lex.tex Resolution.Missing: nothing in the registry has this address
src/HoloSearch.lex.tex Resolution.Ambiguous: a prefix names more than one app
src/HoloSearch.lex.tex gate: HashMismatch, always the reason given first (hash_mismatch_is_reported_first)
src/HoloSearch.lex.tex gate: Refusal.VectorsFailed, as the tampered Calculator with 3 of 22 failing

app.otherwiseWhy: src/HoloSearch.lex.tex gate_ready_exactly: ready exactly when the address, the check and the vectors all pass

properties.why: a model that does not check never runs
a mismatched address is refused, whatever else is true
an ambiguous prefix never opens an app

stakeholders.name: Visitor
stakeholders.text: Pastes an address and needs nothing to run unless it is the app the address names.

stakeholders.name: App publisher
stakeholders.text: Publishes a holo to the registry or IPFS and needs a tampered copy refused with its reason, whichever host serves it.

concerns.name: Refusal names its reason
concerns.text: A refused app is refused with one reason, and a mismatched address is always the reason given first.

components.name: IPFS gateways
components.text: Public IPFS gateways that serve app bytes by CID; Holo Search trusts none of them.

components.name: Registry mirror
components.text: registry/: models, holos, images and layers stored under their digest, with index.json for search, served raw.

components.name: LexLean Wasm runtime
components.text: LexLean's runtime compiled to WebAssembly, which compiles the model and replays its vectors in the browser.

threats.name: Hostile gateway
threats.text: A gateway or mirror serves other bytes under the address.

control.name: Hash in the browser
control.text: The page hashes the bytes before anything runs, and a mismatch is never permitted, proved for every request.

threats.name: Prefix collision
threats.text: An 8-digit prefix resolves to another app than the one the visitor meant.

control.name: Ambiguity is indeterminate
control.text: A prefix that names more than one app is never permitted, proved for every request.

threats.name: Frame module swapped
threats.text: The prism-frame module loaded from the template site is replaced.

control.name: Frame pointer checked
control.text: The page checks the frame module against frame/current.json's SHA-256 before running it, and falls back to a plain address bar.

quality.text: No app opens whose bytes do not hash to the address, whose model does not check, or whose vectors fail.
quality.measureText: Requests with a mismatch, a failed check or a failed vector answered permit.
